ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity; predominantly low-pixel values (dark grey to black) with high-intensity (white) pixels occupying less than 3% of the total visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation across the primary surface. Distinct high-contrast white contiguous cluster mapping to the extreme distal margin of the left lobe. Discrete linear high-intensity streaks mapping to the upper-medial region of the left lobe and the central-medial region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp, acute angle of convergence; bounded by a symmetrical depth relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration; continuous series of jagged peaks and irregular valleys distributed uniformly across the trailing edge boundaries of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitting the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp upward-pointing vertices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed cluster of circular high-contrast pixel anomalies localized at the far-left distal fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent white curvilinear streak on the mid-upper left lobe; one smaller, fainter horizontal white streak on the mid-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized physical trauma or parasitic scarring at the terminal end of the left lobe, characterized by irregular texture and high-intensity pixel clustering.
